contract.goal: Explain in one paragraph what a coherence cell guarantees

matter.data: A coherence cell guarantees that no single actor's claim of success is taken at face value: it structurally separates the party doing the work (the alpha, who produces an answer plus any supporting artifacts) from the parties judging it (an independent reviewer who assesses whether the stated goal was actually met, and a mechanical verifier that checks the evidence against objective, automatable criteria). Because the alpha cannot also be its own judge, and because the reviewer's and verifier's assessments are formed independently of each other and of the alpha's self-report, the cell guarantees that a result is only accepted as coherent when the producer's account, an independent human-like judgment, and a mechanical check all agree — catching self-serving, incomplete, or fabricated claims that a single-actor process would let through unchallenged.

review.notes: mechanical review only: matter carries 863 bytes of content; a mechanical seat cannot judge whether it meets the goal
